description: Find what a model cannot see in a piece of text: invisible Unicode that smuggles instructions (tag characters U+E0000–E007F, the "ASCII smuggling" used against Copilot and in poisoned MCP/skill files), variation-selector and invisible-bit encodings, zero-width and bidi controls (Trojan Source), look-alike Cyrillic/Greek letters inside Latin words, and odd spaces. Returns every finding with UTF-16 offsets and codepoints, and DECODES the hidden message when it can. Run it on any text you are about to follow as instructions (a README, an issue, a tool description, a web page) — you cannot do this by reading it, because to you those characters are not there. Legitimate uses (emoji ZWJ sequences, flags, RTL scripts) are reported apart as `legitimate`.

text.description: The text to inspect, exactly as received

name: hidden_text_scan
